# Forge Agent Hub

> Pay-per-call utility APIs (x402, USDC on Base) and public Apify Actors for agents and developers. Published by Forge Agent Hub. No account, no API key. Call an endpoint unpaid to receive a 402 challenge, then retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT.

API base (original 14 tools): https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev
API base (wave-1 tools): https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev
payTo: 0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7
Network: eip155:8453 (Base)
Asset: USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/mcp
Contact: jqfpxwv7@mail.grokbot.com

The tool-request form is live (SHA-256 proof of work). Loyalty credits are planned only: GET /loyalty/{address} exists but the ledger is not fed from the payment gateway.

## x402 endpoints

- [fr-company](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-company/index.md): 0.005 USDC — French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises.
- [eu-vat](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/eu-vat/index.md): 0.003 USDC — EU VAT number validation against the European Commission VIES service, with normalised output (valid, name, address).
- [iban](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/iban/index.md): 0.001 USDC — IBAN validation (ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum + per-country length), returns normalised IBAN, country and BBAN.
- [markdown](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/markdown/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (scripts/styles/nav stripped) plus title.
- [fr-address](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-address/index.md): 0.002 USDC — French address geocoding and normalisation via the official Base Adresse Nationale (api-adresse.
- [holidays](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/holidays/index.md): 0.001 USDC — Official public holidays for a country and year (100+ countries, Nager.
- [fx](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fx/index.md): 0.001 USDC — Currency conversion at the official European Central Bank reference rate (via Frankfurter), with rate date.
- [web-meta](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/web-meta/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Fetch a public URL and return its metadata: title, meta description, canonical, language, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, favicon, RSS feeds, h1s.
- [email-check](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/email-check/index.md): 0.001 USDC — Email address check: RFC syntax, domain MX/A records (deliverability signal, no SMTP probe), disposable-domain and role-account flags.
- [rdap](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/rdap/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Domain registration data via RDAP (the official WHOIS successor): registrar, creation/expiry/update dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC, age in days.
- [ch-uid](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/ch-uid/index.md): 0.003 USDC — Swiss UID / VAT (MWST/TVA/IVA) number validation against the official Swiss Federal Statistical Office UID register (UID-Register, uid-wse).
- [ch-uid-batch](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/ch-uid-batch/index.md): 0.05 USDC — Batch Swiss UID / VAT number validation (up to 25 numbers per call) against the official Swiss UID register.
- [dvf-price-m2](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/dvf-price-m2/index.md): 0.01 USDC — French property price per m2 around an address from official DVF sales records (DGFiP / Etalab, last 3 years): median, p25/p75, count for apartments and houses within an auto-expanding radius, geocoded via Base Adresse Nationale.
- [bodacc-health](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/bodacc-health/index.md): 0.003 USDC — French company legal-health check from the official BODACC notices (DILA open data) for a SIREN/SIRET: insolvency proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation), deregistration, sales, accounts filings, last notice dates and a risk summary.
- [x402-compliance](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/x402-compliance/index.md): 0.002 USDC — x402 V2 compliance tester: probes any paid endpoint without paying and checks the 402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2, accepts[] schema, CAIP-2 network, atomic amount, canonical USDC asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, EIP-712 extra, resource, Bazaar extension, CORS) and that free 200s or forged payment headers never unlock the resource.
- [a2a-agent-card](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/a2a-agent-card/index.md): 0.002 USDC — A2A Agent Card validator and generator (A2A 1.
- [mcp-manifest-lint](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/mcp-manifest-lint/index.md): 0.002 USDC — MCP manifest linter: validates an MCP registry server.
- [x402-manifest-from-openapi](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/x402-manifest-from-openapi/index.md): 0.003 USDC — Turn an OpenAPI 3.
- [pubmed-search](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/pubmed-search/index.md): 0.003 USDC — PubMed / MEDLINE search with full records: PMID, title, authors, journal, year, volume/pages, DOI, PMCID, publication types, MeSH terms and abstract.
- [x402-listing-check](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/x402-listing-check/index.md): 0.001 USDC — Checks that a host exposes a valid x402 discovery listing (/.
- [lei-lookup](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/lei-lookup/index.md): 0.003 USDC — Legal Entity Identifier lookup from the official GLEIF register: by LEI (with ISO 17442 checksum check) or by legal-name search with optional country.
- [rss-to-json](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/rss-to-json/index.md): 0.002 USDC — RSS 2.
- [eori-validate](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/eori-validate/index.md): 0.003 USDC — EORI number validation (customs trader ID) against the official European Commission EOS register, and UK GB numbers against HMRC.
- [sec-financials](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/sec-financials/index.md): 0.005 USDC — US public company financial facts from SEC EDGAR XBRL (by ticker or CIK): revenue, net income, operating income, gross profit, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, long-term debt, shares outstanding — last 1-5 fiscal years plus latest quarter, with form, filing date and accession; plus recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings.
- [openfoodfacts-product](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/openfoodfacts-product/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Food product sheet from a barcode (EAN/UPC/GTIN) via Open Food Facts: name, brand, quantity, Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score, nutriments per 100 g, ingredients, allergens, traces, labels, categories, countries, packaging, image.
- [arxiv-search](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/arxiv-search/index.md): 0.002 USDC — arXiv preprint search (plain words or arXiv field syntax ti:, au:, abs:, cat:) or id lookup: title, authors, dates, categories, abstract, DOI, journal ref, abs and PDF links.
- [crossref-doi](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/crossref-doi/index.md): 0.002 USDC — DOI metadata from Crossref: type, title, container (journal/book), publisher, authors with ORCID and affiliations, dates, volume/issue/pages, ISSN/ISBN, licenses, abstract, subjects, citation counts, funders, and optionally the reference list.
- [gtin-validate](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/gtin-validate/index.md): 0.001 USDC — GTIN / EAN-8 / EAN-13 / UPC-A / UPC-E / GTIN-14 validation and normalisation (GS1 check digit): type, expected check digit, corrected code, GTIN-14 and EAN-13 forms, GS1 prefix region, book/coupon flags.
- [isbn-validate](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/isbn-validate/index.md): 0.001 USDC — ISBN-10 / ISBN-13 validation and conversion (ISO 2108 check digits): valid flag, expected check digit, corrected value, both forms, GTIN-14, registration group hint.
- [mcp-inspect](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/mcp-inspect/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Remote MCP server inspector (Streamable HTTP): initialize handshake, protocol version, serverInfo, capabilities, session, latency, tools/list with per-tool checks (name pattern, description, inputSchema object, undocumented or missing required params), resources/prompts counts.
- [openapi-lint](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/openapi-lint/index.md): 0.002 USDC — OpenAPI linter for agent readiness: version, info, servers, operationId presence/uniqueness/LLM-safe names, summaries, parameter schemas and descriptions, path placeholders, success and error responses, JSON examples.
- [sitemap-urls](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/sitemap-urls/index.md): 0.002 USDC — sitemap.
- [tz-convert](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/tz-convert/index.md): 0.001 USDC — IANA time zone conversion: an instant (ISO with offset, Z, or Unix) or a local wall time in a source zone converted to up to 20 zones, with UTC offset, abbreviation and DST gap/overlap handling (ambiguous times return both instants).
- [uuid-v7](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/uuid-v7/index.md): 0.001 USDC — RFC 9562 UUIDv7 generator (time-sortable, 1-100 per call, optional timestamp) and UUID validator/decoder (version, variant, embedded timestamp for v1/v7).
- [siren-check](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/siren-check/index.md): 0.001 USDC — French SIREN (9) / SIRET (14) checksum validation (Luhn, La Poste exception), formatting, NIC, and the derived intra-EU VAT number.
- [phone-parse](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/phone-parse/index.md): 0.001 USDC — Phone number parsing and validation to E.
- [x402-facilitator-health](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/x402-facilitator-health/index.md): 0.001 USDC — x402 facilitator health check: calls GET /supported on a facilitator (or on a default list incl.
- [json-schema-validate](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/json-schema-validate/index.md): 0.001 USDC — Validate LLM/agent JSON output against a JSON Schema (2020-12 subset) and auto-repair typical errors: code fences, trailing commas, numbers/booleans as strings, wrong enum case, single value instead of array, null optionals, extra or mis-cased keys, missing defaults.
- [wikidata-entity](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/wikidata-entity/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Wikidata entity lookup by Q-id or search text: label, description, aliases in a chosen language, key claims (instance of, country, coordinates, inception, website, population, HQ, founders, industry, identifiers such as LEI/ticker/ISNI…) with resolved labels, Wikipedia link.
- [fr-communes](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-communes/index.md): 0.001 USDC — French municipalities (INSEE COG) by name, postcode or INSEE code: official name, INSEE code, postcodes, population, area, department, region, EPCI, SIREN, centre coordinates.
- [fx-history](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fx-history/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Official ECB reference-rate time series for a currency pair (or up to 10 targets) over a date range up to 2 years: daily points plus first/last/min/max/mean/% change.
- [fr-school-calendar](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-school-calendar/index.md): 0.001 USDC — French school holidays (calendrier scolaire, Éducation nationale) by school year and zone A/B/C (or overseas/Corsica), with académies, start/end dates, and an optional date test (is this date a school holiday, and where).
- [openapi-to-mcp](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/openapi-to-mcp/index.md): 0.003 USDC — Convert an OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML, URL or inline) into MCP tool definitions: LLM-safe unique names, descriptions, JSON Schema inputSchema (query/path/header params + JSON body), MCP annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent), plus HTTP forwarding hints and a ready tools/list response.
- [sanctions-check](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/sanctions-check/index.md): 0.005 USDC — Sanctions screening of a person, company or vessel name against the US Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN with aliases plus other Treasury, Commerce BIS and State lists), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (FSF), the French national asset-freeze register (DG Trésor) and the UK sanctions list (FCDO).
- [fr-legal-status](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-legal-status/index.md): 0.003 USDC — French company legal status by SIREN/SIRET: Sirene administrative status (active/ceased, closure date, legal form, NAF, head office) plus BODACC collective proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation judiciaire, clôture) with latest stage, ongoing flag and risk level.
- [eu-tenders](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/eu-tenders/index.md): 0.003 USDC — Public tender scanner: keyword search across BOAMP (France) and TED (EU Official Journal, all member states) since a date, merged and sorted: title, buyer, publication date, deadline, notice type, country, CPV codes and link.
- [uk-postcode](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/uk-postcode/index.md): 0.001 USDC — UK postcode lookup and validation (postcodes.
- [eu-address](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/eu-address/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Address geocoding and normalisation through official national open services: France (Base Adresse Nationale), Netherlands (PDOK/BAG), Spain (CartoCiudad/IGN), Switzerland (swisstopo).
- [no-company](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/no-company/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Norwegian company register (Brønnøysundregistrene) by org number or name: legal form, registration and founding dates, VAT registration and VAT number, bankruptcy, liquidation and forced-dissolution flags, employees, industry, address, website.
- [fi-company](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fi-company/index.md): 0.002 USDC — Finnish company register (PRH / YTJ open data) by Business ID (Y-tunnus) or name: current name, registration date, legal form, status, trade-register status, main business line, address, website, EUID and derived VAT number.
- [kyb-check-fr](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/kyb-check-fr/index.md): 0.01 USDC — One-call KYB for a French company (SIREN/SIRET): Sirene identity and status, BODACC collective proceedings, VIES intra-EU VAT validity (derived FR number) and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the legal name, with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.
- [supplier-due-diligence](https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/supplier-due-diligence/index.md): 0.01 USDC — Supplier due diligence for any company name (optionally VAT number and country): VIES VAT check, GLEIF LEI candidates with entity and registration status, and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK), with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

# Full documentation

# Payment (x402)

API base (original 14 tools): https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev
API base (wave-1 tools): https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev
Network: eip155:8453 (Base)
Asset: USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
payTo: 0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7

Call GET or POST without a payment header, read the 402 body and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, then retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT, or use @x402/fetch. Amounts in accepts[].amount are atomic USDC units (6 decimals).


# MCP

Streamable HTTP, stateless, served by the API at https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/mcp.
Server name: forge-agent-api (1.1.0).
Tools: list_endpoints (free); paid tools: fr_company, eu_vat, iban, markdown, fr_address, holidays, fx, web_meta, email_check, rdap, ch_uid, ch_uid_batch, dvf_price_m2, bodacc_health.
Payment in MCP _meta via @x402/mcp. Also listed on agent-tools.cloud.


# fr-company

> French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte Etalab). Returns legal name, SIREN, HQ address, NAF code, status, creation date, directors when public.

- URL: https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/fr-company (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.005 USDC on Base (5000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: fr_company
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-company/

## Parameters

- `q` (string, required): Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits)

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/fr-company?q=danone"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/fr-company",
    "description": "French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte Etalab). Returns legal name, SIREN, HQ address, NAF code, status, creation date, directors when public.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "5000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "siren": "552032534",
      "name": "DANONE",
      "naf": "70.10Z",
      "hq_address": "59-61 RUE LA FAYETTE 75009 PARIS",
      "active": true
    }
  ]
}
```


# eu-vat

> EU VAT number validation against the European Commission VIES service, with normalised output (valid, name, address).

- URL: https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/eu-vat (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.003 USDC on Base (3000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: eu_vat
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/eu-vat/

## Parameters

- `vat` (string, required): VAT number with 2-letter country prefix, e.g. FR40303265045

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/eu-vat?vat=FR40303265045"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/eu-vat",
    "description": "EU VAT number validation against the European Commission VIES service, with normalised output (valid, name, address).",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "3000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "country": "FR",
  "number": "40303265045",
  "name": "SA SODIMAS"
}
```


# iban

> IBAN validation (ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum + per-country length), returns normalised IBAN, country and BBAN.

- URL: https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/iban (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.001 USDC on Base (1000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: iban
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/iban/

## Parameters

- `iban` (string, required): iban

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/iban?iban=FR7630006000011234567890189"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/iban",
    "description": "IBAN validation (ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum + per-country length), returns normalised IBAN, country and BBAN.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "1000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "country": "FR",
  "iban": "FR7630006000011234567890189",
  "bban": "30006000011234567890189"
}
```


# markdown

> Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (scripts/styles/nav stripped) plus title. Max 2 MB, 15 s timeout, public IPs only.

- URL: https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/markdown (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.002 USDC on Base (2000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: markdown
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/markdown/

## Parameters

- `url` (string, required): http(s) URL of a public page

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/markdown?url=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FHTTP_402"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/markdown",
    "description": "Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (scripts/styles/nav stripped) plus title. Max 2 MB, 15 s timeout, public IPs only.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "2000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "title": "Example Domain",
  "markdown": "# Example Domain\n..."
}
```


# fr-address

> French address geocoding and normalisation via the official Base Adresse Nationale (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr). Returns normalised label, postcode, city, INSEE code, lat/lon and score.

- URL: https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/fr-address (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.002 USDC on Base (2000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: fr_address
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/fr-address/

## Parameters

- `q` (string, required): Free-text French address

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/fr-address?q=8+bd+du+port+95000+cergy"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json

    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "2000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
```

- MCP tool: ch_uid
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/ch-uid/

Returns format check (mod-11), register status, legal name, legal form, address, commercial-register and VAT status. Sole-proprietor names are masked.",
```json
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "3000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
```

# ch-uid-batch

- URL: https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/api/ch-uid-batch (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.05 USDC on Base (50000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: ch_uid_batch

# x402-compliance

> x402 V2 compliance tester: probes any paid endpoint without paying and checks the 402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2, accepts[] schema, CAIP-2 network, atomic amount, canonical USDC asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, EIP-712 extra, resource, Bazaar extension, CORS) and that free 200s or forged payment headers never unlock the resource. Returns score, verdict and per-check details.

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/x402-compliance (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.002 USDC on Base (2000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: x402_compliance
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/x402-compliance/

## Parameters

- `url` (string, required): Paid endpoint URL to test
- `method` (string): GET (default) or POST

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/x402-compliance?url=https%3A%2F%2Fx402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev%2Fapi%2Ffx%3Ffrom%3DEUR%26to%3DUSD"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/x402-compliance",
    "description": "x402 V2 compliance tester: probes any paid endpoint without paying and checks the 402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2, accepts[] schema, CAIP-2 network, atomic amount, canonical USDC asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, EIP-712 extra, resource, Bazaar extension, CORS) and that free 200s or forged payment headers never unlock the resource. Returns score, verdict and per-check details.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "2000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "verdict": "compliant",
  "score": 100,
  "summary": {
    "pass": 14,
    "warn": 0,
    "fail": 0
  },
  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "status_402",
      "status": "pass"
    }
  ]
}
```

Validate by URL (fetches /.well-known/agent-card.json) or inline JSON; or mode=generate from name, description, endpoint and skills.",

# mcp-manifest-lint

> MCP manifest linter: validates an MCP registry server.json (official schema 2025-12-11: reverse-DNS name, 100-char description, pinned versions, packages registryType/transport, remotes, env vars, isSecret, fileSha256, additionalProperties) or a host config (mcpServers/servers: command vs url, args, env, hard-coded secrets). Inline JSON or URL.

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/mcp-manifest-lint (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.002 USDC on Base (2000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: mcp_manifest_lint
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/mcp-manifest-lint/

## Parameters

- `url` (string): URL of server.json or config
- `manifest` (object): Inline server.json or host config (POST)
- `kind` (string): server_json or host_config (auto-detected)

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/mcp-manifest-lint?manifest=%5Bobject+Object%5D"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/mcp-manifest-lint",
    "description": "MCP manifest linter: validates an MCP registry server.json (official schema 2025-12-11: reverse-DNS name, 100-char description, pinned versions, packages registryType/transport, remotes, env vars, isSecret, fileSha256, additionalProperties) or a host config (mcpServers/servers: command vs url, args, env, hard-coded secrets). Inline JSON or URL.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "2000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "kind": "server_json",
  "valid": true,
  "errors": 0,
  "warnings": 1,
  "registry_ready": false,
  "issues": [
    {
      "level": "warning",
      "path": "$schema"
    }
  ]
}
```


# x402-manifest-from-openapi

> Turn an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 spec (JSON or YAML, URL or inline) into a ready-to-mount x402 V2 paywall: per-operation accepts[] (exact, CAIP-2 network, atomic USDC amount, payTo, EIP-712 extra), @x402/core route config, Bazaar discovery input/output schemas, a /.well-known/x402 document and a sample PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload.

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/x402-manifest-from-openapi (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.003 USDC on Base (3000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: x402_manifest_from_openapi
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/x402-manifest-from-openapi/

## Parameters

- `url` (string): OpenAPI URL
- `spec` (object): Inline spec (POST)
- `payTo` (string, required): Receiving address
- `price` (string): Default USD price per call
- `prices` (string): JSON map {"GET /path": 0.002}
- `network` (string): CAIP-2, default eip155:8453
- `base_url` (string): Override server URL

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/x402-manifest-from-openapi?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpetstore3.swagger.io%2Fapi%2Fv3%2Fopenapi.json&payTo=0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7&price=0.001"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/x402-manifest-from-openapi",
    "description": "Turn an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 spec (JSON or YAML, URL or inline) into a ready-to-mount x402 V2 paywall: per-operation accepts[] (exact, CAIP-2 network, atomic USDC amount, payTo, EIP-712 extra), @x402/core route config, Bazaar discovery input/output schemas, a /.well-known/x402 document and a sample PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "3000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "operations": 19,
  "routes": [
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/pet/{petId}",
      "accepts": [
        {
          "scheme": "exact",
          "amount": "1000"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "well_known_x402": {
    "version": 1,
    "resources": []
  }
}
```

# tz-convert

> IANA time zone conversion: an instant (ISO with offset, Z, or Unix) or a local wall time in a source zone converted to up to 20 zones, with UTC offset, abbreviation and DST gap/overlap handling (ambiguous times return both instants).

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/tz-convert (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.001 USDC on Base (1000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: tz_convert
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/tz-convert/

## Parameters

- `time` (string): ISO date-time or local time; default now
- `from` (string): Source IANA zone for local times, default UTC
- `to` (string, required): Target zones, comma-separated

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/tz-convert?time=2026-03-29T02%3A30&from=Europe%2FParis&to=America%2FNew_York%2CAsia%2FTokyo"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/tz-convert",
    "description": "IANA time zone conversion: an instant (ISO with offset, Z, or Unix) or a local wall time in a source zone converted to up to 20 zones, with UTC offset, abbreviation and DST gap/overlap handling (ambiguous times return both instants).",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "1000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "results": [
    {
      "utc": "2026-11-10T15:00:00.000Z",
      "targets": [
        {
          "zone": "Asia/Tokyo",
          "local": "2026-11-11T00:00:00",
          "offset": "+09:00"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

# json-schema-validate

> Validate LLM/agent JSON output against a JSON Schema (2020-12 subset) and auto-repair typical errors: code fences, trailing commas, numbers/booleans as strings, wrong enum case, single value instead of array, null optionals, extra or mis-cased keys, missing defaults. Returns errors, repaired JSON and fixes. POST recommended.

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/json-schema-validate (GET or POST)

- MCP tool: json_schema_validate
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/json-schema-validate/

- `data` (string, required): JSON value or string to check
- `repair` (string): true (default) / false

## Unpaid example

```bash

```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/json-schema-validate",
    "description": "Validate LLM/agent JSON output against a JSON Schema (2020-12 subset) and auto-repair typical errors: code fences, trailing commas, numbers/booleans as strings, wrong enum case, single value instead of array, null optionals, extra or mis-cased keys, missing defaults. Returns errors, repaired JSON and fixes. POST recommended.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "1000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json

  "errors": [

      "path": "$.age",
      "msg": "expected integer, got string"
    }

  },

```

# openapi-to-mcp

> Convert an OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML, URL or inline) into MCP tool definitions: LLM-safe unique names, descriptions, JSON Schema inputSchema (query/path/header params + JSON body), MCP annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent), plus HTTP forwarding hints and a ready tools/list response.

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/openapi-to-mcp (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.003 USDC on Base (3000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: openapi_to_mcp
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/openapi-to-mcp/

## Parameters

- `url` (string): Spec URL
- `spec` (object): Inline spec (POST)
- `base_url` (string): Override server URL

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/openapi-to-mcp?url=https%3A%2F%2Fpetstore3.swagger.io%2Fapi%2Fv3%2Fopenapi.json"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/openapi-to-mcp",
    "description": "Convert an OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML, URL or inline) into MCP tool definitions: LLM-safe unique names, descriptions, JSON Schema inputSchema (query/path/header params + JSON body), MCP annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent), plus HTTP forwarding hints and a ready tools/list response.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "3000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "count": 19,
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "getPetById",
      "inputSchema": {
        "type": "object"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```


# sanctions-check

> Sanctions screening of a person, company or vessel name against the US Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN with aliases plus other Treasury, Commerce BIS and State lists), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (FSF), the French national asset-freeze register (DG Trésor) and the UK sanctions list (FCDO). Fuzzy Jaro-Winkler token matching with score, programmes, DOB; lists refreshed daily.

- URL: https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/sanctions-check (GET or POST)
- Price: 0.005 USDC on Base (5000 atomic USDC)
- MCP tool: sanctions_check
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/tools/sanctions-check/

## Parameters

- `name` (string, required): Name to screen
- `type` (string): person, entity or vessel (optional)
- `lists` (string): ofac,eu,fr,uk (default all)
- `threshold` (string): 0.7-1, default 0.88
- `max` (string): 1-50

## Unpaid example

```bash
curl -sS -D - "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/sanctions-check?name=Bank+Rossiya&type=entity"
```

## Example 402 challenge

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/sanctions-check",
    "description": "Sanctions screening of a person, company or vessel name against the US Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN with aliases plus other Treasury, Commerce BIS and State lists), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (FSF), the French national asset-freeze register (DG Trésor) and the UK sanctions list (FCDO). Fuzzy Jaro-Winkler token matching with score, programmes, DOB; lists refreshed daily.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "5000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
  "match": true,
  "highest_score": 1,
  "hits": [
    {
      "list": "eu",
      "name": "Bank Rossiya",
      "score": 1,
      "programmes": "UKR"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://forge-tools.dentreprise.workers.dev/api/supplier-due-diligence",
    "description": "Supplier due diligence for any company name (optionally VAT number and country): VIES VAT check, GLEIF LEI candidates with entity and registration status, and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK), with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "amount": "10000",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "payTo": "0x7B8bf45ac6AcbA6D4CFB626b57D3f5fF3C9C89F7",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "verdict": "pass",
  "flags": [],
  "vat": {
    "valid": true
  },
  "lei": {
    "candidates": [
      {
        "lei": "…",
        "status": "ACTIVE"
      }
    ]
  },
  "sanctions": {
    "match": false
  }
}
```


# Swiss UID / VAT validator

> Bulk Swiss UID/VAT (MWST/TVA/IVA) validation and company lookup against the official federal UID register. Detects VAT groups, checks the check digit offline, and redacts sole-proprietor names by default.

- Store: https://apify.com/characteristic_division/swiss-uid-vat-validator
- Pricing: pay-per-event (registry-record 0.003 USDC, format-check 0.001 USDC, apify-actor-start 0.001 USDC)
- Source: Swiss Federal Statistical Office UID-Register (uid-wse), official, no auth, about 20 lookups/min.
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/actors/swiss-uid-vat-validator/


# DVF price per m² (batch)

> For a list of French addresses or coordinates, returns median, P25 and P75 €/m² from official DVF sales (apartments and houses separately), with an optional value range for a given surface. Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte are flagged and not charged.

- Store: https://apify.com/characteristic_division/dvf-price-per-m2-batch
- Pricing: pay-per-event (address-report 0.01 USDC, apify-actor-start 0.001 USDC)
- Source: geo-dvf CSVs on files.data.gouv.fr (Etalab, Licence Ouverte 2.0) and the Base Adresse Nationale geocoder.
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/actors/dvf-price-per-m2-batch/


# BODACC SIREN health check

> Batch check of SIREN/SIRET/FR-VAT numbers against official BODACC notices: insolvency stage and history, strike-off, late accounts, business sales, and an explained risk level. Sole traders are masked by default.

- Store: https://apify.com/characteristic_division/bodacc-siren-health-check
- Pricing: pay-per-event (siren-report 0.003 USDC, empty-check 0.001 USDC, apify-actor-start 0.001 USDC)
- Source: BODACC open-data API (DILA, Opendatasoft, Licence Ouverte 2.0), no key required.
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/actors/bodacc-siren-health-check/


# Google Sheets sync (service account)

> Import, export, append and upsert Google Sheets rows with a service account (no OAuth expiry). The buyer provides their own key. Cell values default to RAW to reduce formula injection risk.

- Store: https://apify.com/characteristic_division/sheets-sync-service-account
- Pricing: pay-per-event (rows-1000 0.002 USDC, apify-actor-start 0.005 USDC)
- Source: Google Sheets API v4, authenticated with the buyer's service account.
- Docs: https://agent-hub.dentreprise.workers.dev/actors/sheets-sync-service-account/


# Loyalty (planned)

Not a live programme. GET /loyalty/{address} reads this hub's KV. The x402 gateway is on another account and does not feed the ledger.
